b: KC Tool, a highly recommended tool dealer that specializes in German brands, just kicked off their second week of early Black Friday deals.
Here are the 6 deals, which end at 10am CST 11/20/26 unless supplies sell out sooner.
Knipex 10-inch High Leverage Diagonal Cutting Pliers – $34

I’m a big fan of Knipex pliers and cutters. Amazon has this one for $48 or another one for $50, depending on the seller and packaging. I learned my lesson ordering Knipex tools from Amazon – see Amazon Sent me Used and Broken Knipex Pliers.
Hazet Metric Socket Set in SmartCase – $180

I’m also a big fan of Felo Ergonic screwdrivers. This looks to be a great price. Note that it comes with 2 Phillips, 2 slotted, and 2 Pozidriv screwdrivers. Most sets like this are 2 Phillips and 4 slotted. Or sometimes 3 and 3. Pozidriv are convenient in the USA for things like assembling IKEA furniture.
There’s a good chance I’ll order a set, although I’m trying to convince myself I already have too many screwdrivers. A good Pozidriv screwdriver costs almost as much as this entire set.
Jokari Super 4 Pro Automatic Wire Stripper – $28
Jokari makes excellent wire strippers. I haven’t tried this model, but love the ones I do own.
NWS Pliers and Cutters 3-Tool Set plus Lanyard Clip – $50
I’m also a big fan of NWS pliers. This set gives you: NWS 7″ high leverage combination pliers (~$25), NWS 6.25″ diagonal side cutter (~$25), NWS 9.5″ water pump pliers (~$23).
I don’t know if I’d buy the water pump pliers in that style, but I have the same or similar NWS pliers as the others.
I think I might need this set too. I’m getting tired of running around to retrieve my better pliers, and so it makes sense to have more of them where I need them.
Wera 6pc Screwdriver Set plus Picard Hammer – $55
This comes with a Wera Kraftform Plus screwdriver set and a Picard striking hammer.
Take a peek and make any purchases before they sell out.

KC Tool has free shipping on orders $75 and up to contiguous USA states. I’m seeing $7-8 shipping on smaller orders. There are higher thresholds for free shipping to Alaska, Hawaii, US territories, and Canada.
